answered.sql: SELECT T2.audience_rating FROM Role AS T1 JOIN FilmReviews AS T2 ON T1.film_id = T2.film_id JOIN Actor AS T3 ON T1.actor_id = T3.id WHERE T3.name = 'Leonardo DiCaprio'

candidates.meaning: Find the rating of the movies in which Leonardo DiCaprio has acted.
candidates.sql: SELECT FR.critic_rating, FR.audience_rating, F.title FROM FilmReviews FR JOIN Film F ON FR.film_id = F.id JOIN Role R ON F.id = R.film_id JOIN Actor A ON R.actor_id = A.id WHERE A.name = 'Leonardo DiCaprio'

candidates.meaning: Find the ratings of movies where Leonardo DiCaprio is an actor.
candidates.sql: SELECT Film.title, FilmReviews.critic_rating, FilmReviews.audience_rating FROM Film JOIN FilmReviews ON Film.id = FilmReviews.film_id JOIN Role ON Film.id = Role.film_id WHERE Role.actor_id = (SELECT id FROM Actor WHERE name = 'Leonardo DiCaprio')

candidates.meaning: Find the ratings of movies where Leonardo DiCaprio has a role.
candidates.sql: SELECT Film.title, FilmReviews.critic_rating, FilmReviews.audience_rating FROM Film JOIN FilmReviews ON Film.id = FilmReviews.film_id JOIN Role ON Film.id = Role.film_id WHERE Role.actor_id = (SELECT id FROM Actor WHERE name = 'Leonardo DiCaprio')

candidates.meaning: Find the ratings of movies starring Leonardo DiCaprio.
candidates.sql: SELECT Film.title, FilmReviews.critic_rating, FilmReviews.audience_rating FROM Film JOIN FilmReviews ON Film.id = FilmReviews.film_id WHERE Film.id IN (SELECT film_id FROM Role WHERE actor_id = (SELECT id FROM Actor WHERE name = 'Leonardo DiCaprio'))
